name: Fungus Man King (FGG, CR 4) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Fungus Man King (FGG, CR 4) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Fungus Man King (FGG, CR 11)" but are not part of the Fungus Man King (FGG, CR 4) entry, which is unchanged.

hp 132 (12d8+78)
Fort +16, Ref +4, Will +11; +4 bonus vs. confusion, daze, feeblemind, and insanity effects, +4 bonus vs. extraordinary, spell-like, and supernatural abilities of creatures with shapechanger subtype
Defensive Abilities bramble armor (1d6+3, 6 rounds/day); DR 5/piercing or slashing; Immune plant traits; Resist cold 5
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee slam +12 (1d6+7)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks spore cloud, wild shape 2/day, wooden fists (+3, 5 rounds/day)
Druid Spells Prepared (CL 6th; concentration +8)

3rd—plant growthD, protection from energy, speak with plants
2nd—barkskinD, flame blade, fog cloud, hold animal (DC 14), protection from spores
1st—charm animal (DC 13), entangleD (DC 13), obscuring mist, produce flame, thunderstomp

SQ nature bond (Plant domain), nature sense, resist call of the wild, trackless step, wild empathy +6

Bramble Armor (6 rounds/day) (Su)

Foes striking the fungus king with non-reach weapons take 1d6+3 slashing damage from brambles cutting their flesh.

Darkvision (30 ft.)

The fungus king can see perfectly in the dark up to 30 ft. (black and white only).

Natural Spell

The fungus king can cast spells while using wild shape.

Nature Sense (Ex)

Vulnerability to Fire

The fungus king is vulnerable (suffers +50% damage) to fire damage.

Wild Empathy +6 (Ex)

A fungus king can improve the attitude of an animal, as if using Diplomacy.

Wild Shape (6 hours, 2/day) (Su)

The fungus king can shapeshift into a different creature twice per day.

Wild Speech

The fungus king can speak while using wild shape.

Wooden Fists +3 (5 rounds/day) (Su)

Unarmed attacks made by a fungus king are lethal, do not provoke AoO, and deal +3 damage.

Carved into the stump of a huge toadstool are petroglyphs detailing the legend of Magopyccic, a colossal sentient fungus whose spores are said to have spread throughout the cosmos, devouring worlds and granting their desiccated husks to its fungoid offspring. Searching the stump reveals a secret compartment within the mouth of the Magopyccic, where the fungus folk gather their treasures.

TREASURE

potion of bull’s strength, scroll of plant growth, scroll of stoneskin, staff of swarming insects, and 20 rare moonstone gems worth 100 gp each.
